subject: Kickoff: Project Tundra — structured parsing of clinical assessment & plan text
body:
Hi Deshawn, team,

Kicking off structured understanding of assessment and plans in clinician documentation. Internally this effort is Project Tundra — Wei set up the shared drive and the run tracker under that name, so please use it in invites and docs.

The task: take the free-text assessment-and-plan section of a clinical note and produce structure — problem clusters and the action items attached to them. The released pipeline runs a Beam job over notes in the MIMIC-III note_event CSV format plus the published annotation ratings, then trains the AP-parsing model.

Product framing: structured A&P is the input our care-coordination summarizer has been missing.

Milestones: data generation and vocabulary build by late May, model training and eval in June, readout the week of July 20. Privacy Review must be filed before any note data moves.

Dmitri
